# `item`

A kind of item: what it is made of, how it is held and worn, what it holds and what it confers (06 §9.1).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `unknown_name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What it is called by someone who has not learned what it is (05 §4.6).
- `description` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a closer look says of it.
- `material` (id of a [`material`](material.md); **required**): What it is made of. It takes damage as that material does.
- `mass` ([mass](../units.md#mass) in `kg`; **required**): The mass of one.
- `volume` ([volume](../units.md#volume) in `m3`, or `null`; optional): The space one takes up. Left out, its mass over its material's density.
- `length` ([length](../units.md#length) in `m`; optional): How long it is along its greatest dimension.
- `tags` (list of [tag](../values.md#tags); optional): Free-form tags. An item is made with them as its own.
- `surfaces` (list of object [`SurfaceDef`](#surfacedef); optional): The parts of it that can be brought to bear (07 §3.2). Carried for combat.
- `grip` (object, id of a [`channel`](channel.md) → whole number, 0 or more; optional): The channel slots needed to hold it in a grasp. An item with none cannot be held in one.
- `wear` ([`Wear`](#wear); optional): The layers it adds over the parts it is worn on. An item with none cannot be worn.
- `holds` (object [`HoldsDef`](#holdsdef), or `null`; optional): Its capacity as a container. An item with none holds nothing.
- `stack` (`true` or `false`; optional): Whether equal items may share one entity with a count.
- `modifiers` (list of object [`ModifierDef`](#modifierdef); optional): Attribute modifiers on whoever holds it in a grasp or wears it.
- `holder_tags` (list of string; optional): Tags added to whoever holds it in a grasp or wears it, while they do.
- `grants` (list of id of a [`action`](action.md); optional): Actions whoever holds or wears it may use. Carried for the action runtime.
- `traits` (list of string; optional): Traits given to whoever holds or wears it, by id. Carried until traits are built.
- `rules` (list of [`eoc`](eoc.md), by id or [written in place](../values.md#inline-definitions); optional): Rules attached to whoever holds or wears it. Carried for the rule runtime.
- `guards` (object, name → number; optional): While worn, the share of exposure it keeps out, by route (02 §16). Carried until exposure reads it.
- `contains` ([volume](../units.md#volume) in `m3`, or `null`; optional): A volume of substances it can hold as a mixture (16 §9.5). Carried until substances are built.
- `color` ([`ColorChoice`](#colorchoice); optional): The colour an item of this kind carries.
- `glyph` (object [`GlyphSpec`](#glyphspec), or `null`; optional): How it is drawn.
- `contents` (list of object [`ContentDef`](#contentdef); optional): What a container of this kind is found to hold when it is first opened (06 §9.3).
- `ages` (object [`AgesDef`](#agesdef), or `null`; optional): How it ages. Carried as data.
- `keeps` (object [`KeepsDef`](#keepsdef), or `null`; optional): What it keeps for its contents. Carried as data.
- `interactions` (list of id of a [`interaction`](interaction.md); optional): The interactions it offers (16 §3.2), done to it as an entity.

<a id="surfacedef"></a>
### `SurfaceDef`

Something a part can strike with (06 §6.1; 07 §3.2). The body model carries it for combat and gives it no meaning.

- `id` (string; **required**): Its name among the part's surfaces.
- `kind` (id of a [`damage_type`](damage_type.md); **required**): The damage type it delivers.
- `area` (number; **required**): Contact area, in square metres.
- `give` ([length](../units.md#length) in `m`; **required**): The distance over which a strike with it is stopped.
- `span` ([length](../units.md#length) in `m`; optional): The length of contact across the target.

<a id="wear"></a>
### `Wear`

An item's `wear`: one entry or a list of them.

Written as a `wear` entry, or a list of them.

Takes:

- an object: object [`WearDef`](#weardef)
- a list: list of object [`WearDef`](#weardef)

<a id="holdsdef"></a>
### `HoldsDef`

An item's `holds`: its capacity as a container (06 §9.1).

- `volume` ([volume](../units.md#volume) in `m3`, or `null`; optional): The most space what is stowed in it may take up. Left out, any amount.
- `mass` ([mass](../units.md#mass) in `kg`, or `null`; optional): The most what is stowed in it may weigh, with everything inside that. Left out, any amount.
- `accepts` (list of string; optional): The tags it takes: an item goes in if it carries at least one of them. Empty for anything.

<a id="modifierdef"></a>
### `ModifierDef`

An attribute modifier an item confers on whoever holds it in a grasp or wears it (06 §9.1, §4.1).

- `attr` (id of a [`attribute`](attribute.md); **required**): The attribute.
- `add` (number; optional): Added to the attribute's base. Default 0.
- `mul` (number; optional): Multiplied in after every addition. Default 1.

<a id="colorchoice"></a>
### `ColorChoice`

The colour an item carries (06 §9.1): none, one, or one picked from a list when the item is made.

In data: a colour's name, or a list of names.

Written as a colour's name, or a list of names.

Takes:

- a string
- a list: list of string

<a id="glyphspec"></a>
### `GlyphSpec`

How an element is drawn. A presentation hint: the world stores it and gives it no meaning.

- `ch` (string, or `null`; optional): The character.
- `fg` (string, or `null`; optional): The foreground colour: a colour name, or `"material"`.
- `bg` (string, or `null`; optional): The background colour: a colour name, or `"material"`.

<a id="contentdef"></a>
### `ContentDef`

One entry of a container's `contents`: what it is found to hold when it is first opened (06 §9.3).

- `item` (id of a [`item`](item.md); **required**): What is in it.
- `count` ([`CountRange`](#countrange); optional): How many: a number, or `[least, most]`. Default 1.
- `chance` (number; optional): The chance that it is there at all, from 0 to 1. Default 1.

<a id="agesdef"></a>
### `AgesDef`

An item's `ages` (06 §9.4). Carried as data: ageing is not built.

- `life` ([time](../units.md#time) in `s`; **required**): How long the item lasts at a rate of 1.
- `rate` (string, or `null`; optional): The rate, as an expression about where the item is. Kept as it was written until ageing compiles it.
- `stages` (list of object [`StageDef`](#stagedef); optional): The stages on the way.
- `into` (id of a [`item`](item.md), or `null`; optional): What the item becomes at the end. Left out, it is removed.

<a id="keepsdef"></a>
### `KeepsDef`

What a container keeps for its contents (06 §9.4). Carried as data: ageing is not built.

- `temperature` ([temperature](../units.md#temperature) in `K`, or `null`; optional): The temperature its contents read in place of the room's.
- `ageing` (number, or `null`; optional): A factor on the ageing of its contents.

<a id="weardef"></a>
### `WearDef`

One entry of an item's `wear`: a layer the item adds over some parts of whoever wears it (06 §9.1, §7.2).

- `parts` ([`PartSelector`](#partselector); **required**): The parts it covers.
- `layer` (whole number; optional): Its order among what is worn over a part: a higher layer is further out. A part takes one item at each layer. Default 0.
- `material` (id of a [`material`](material.md), or `null`; optional): What the layer is made of. Left out, the item's own material.
- `thickness` ([length](../units.md#length) in `m`; **required**): How thick the layer is there.
- `coverage` (number; optional): The share of hits on a covered part that the layer is in the way of, from 0 to 1. Default 1.

<a id="countrange"></a>
### `CountRange`

How many of something: one number, or a range drawn from evenly.

In data: `3`, or `[1, 5]`.

Written as a count, or `[least, most]`.

Takes:

- an integer
- a list: list of 2: whole number, 0 or more, whole number, 0 or more

<a id="stagedef"></a>
### `StageDef`

A stage of an item's ageing (06 §9.4). Carried as data: ageing is not built.

- `at` (number; **required**): The age, from 0 to 1, at which the stage is reached.
- `trait` (string, or `null`; optional): The trait the item is given there, by id.

<a id="partselector"></a>
### `PartSelector`

Which parts of a body a `wear` entry covers: every outer part, or those that answer to one of a list of names.

A part answers to a name if the name is its name in its body (`l_arm`), the id of its definition, qualified or bare (`arm`), or a tag its definition carries (`limb`).

In data: `"all"`, one name, or a list of names.

Written as "all", a part's name, or a list of names.

Takes:

- a string
- a list: list of string
